title: AAPS 3.0.0.0.1 OpenHumans Upload doesn't work anymore
symptom: OpenHumans data no longer uploads; log shows UnsupportedOperationException: Tried to obtain display from a Context not associated with one.
cause: The code attempts to get display metrics from a background context, which is not allowed on Android 11+ (API 30).
fix: Comment out the if statement in OpenHumansUploader.kt around line 236 that obtains display metrics; the issue was fixed by commit 60f5115ce63d91ee2330dfc0dac0eb6fd301b538.
